Maya (CSM): Heads-up: Windward Logistics wants to onboard a custom supply-chain NER model (internal name: windward-ner-7b). They need Private (VPC) deployment, PHI-safe handling, and a 99th pct latency SLO < 300ms. Renewal in ~6 weeks — timeline is critical. They provided an eval dataset and a safety checklist. Looping in Solutions and Onboarding.

Jin (Solutions Eng): Thanks — can you paste the customer ask + dataset link? Need model format, tokenizer, quantization preference, memory footprint, and whether there are any custom ops. Also: do they require Dedicated GPUs or is shared Dedicated sufficient?

Maya (CSM): Link (secure): https://windward-secure.s3/windward-ner-2026.zip. Model: 7B PyTorch FP16 checkpoint (converted to Redwood format v1.2). They asked about 8-bit quantized runtime to save costs and a private VPC deployment. They also want KMS integration and retention controls.

Sam (Onboarding Eng): We can take this. Quick intake checklist: 1) verify checkpoint & tokenizer, 2) run safety evals on provided dataset, 3) perf profile + quantization experiment, 4) privacy/retention review. I can spin a private preview pod. ETA: perf + safety smoke in 3 business days if model uses standard ops. Need sample prompts (~50) and gold labels.

Maya (CSM): Customer will send prompts + labels by EOD. They flagged PHI in some examples — asked whether Redwood can do record-level redaction or KMS-backed field masking. Also asked about audit logs for inference.

OnboardBot: OnboardBot created intake ticket #CS-2027 for Windward model. Workflow: ingest -> safety -> perf -> preview -> rollout. Assigned to: Sam (Onboarding Eng).

Jin (Solutions Eng): Note on latency: 7B quantized on older GPUs (T4) might struggle for 99p < 300ms for longer sequences. Recommend Dedicated A10x or A100 for that SLO, or apply KV-cache prefixing and sequence-length limits. We'll prepare two profiles for them: cost-optimized quantized (target ~280ms typical, 99p may spike) and FP16 high-SLO (typical ~170-200ms).

Liam (AE): @Maya thanks for flag. I’ll mark renewal as at-risk if onboarding slips. Can Solutions confirm a preview/demo date? If we can show a preview next week, I’ll schedule exec review with Windward.

Sam (Onboarding Eng): Confirming: starting format checks now. If we detect custom CUDA ops it'll add ~48 hours for build & validation. If no custom ops, I'll run quantization profiles and safety evals and post a perf+safety report by Wed.

Maya (CSM): Customer asked about E2E eval dashboard and who will own alerts for quality regressions. Recommend we assign a CS+SE owner for the first 60 days post-rollout. @Liam can you confirm coverage for exec touchpoints?

Liam (AE): I will own the renewal outreach and attend the exec review. If they want reserved capacity I'll work PO/contract with them. :thumbsup:

Maya (CSM): Great — updating Windward with the plan and timeline. Sam — please add 'renewal-risk' tag to the intake ticket.

OnboardBot: Tag added: renewal-risk. Ticket #CS-2027 notes updated with timeline (perf+safety by Wed) and assignee (Sam).
